# TC.ProbabilityInterval

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.ProbabilityInterval"></a>

### TC.ProbabilityInterval

Shared probability interval: ordered finite bounds in 0..1. Intervals can
correlate different products; marginal probability alone loses that correlation.

### max

Native upper endpoint in 0..1, at least min.

```text
number
```

### min

Inclusive native lower endpoint in 0..1, at most max.

```text
number
```
